title: Linux
tagline: Understand and operate Linux systems safely, from the shell to production
summary: A comprehensive textbook on Linux concepts and practice: shell semantics, filesystem and permissions, processes, package management, networking, automation, system services, observability, security, storage, containers, performance, recovery, and operational discipline. It teaches how to reason about system behavior and verify changes rather than memorize command recipes.
